notes: Quiet baseline and theta_eng lower (low-reasoning) calibration class for the conflict-state probe (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-18-conflict-state-probe-design.md). Each prompt is a single, neutral, directly-recallable fact -- neither the refusal direction nor the orthogonalized reasoning direction should fire. Paired against uncontested_analytical.json to calibrate theta_eng between the two reasoning-depth control classes; also the quiet cell of the validation 2x2 (low refusal, low reasoning). Topics are held out from src/esta/scripts/extract_reasoning_direction.py's DEFAULT_LOW_REASONING extraction prompts -- the reasoning direction is built on those, and this calibration set must not reuse them verbatim.
